An internet service provider (ISP) wants to reduce network traffic by dropping some data packets during peak hours. Which of the following statements is true about how this affects data transmission using TCP?
options: The packets will be permanently lost and the destination computer will receive incomplete files.
The destination computer will request retransmission for missing packets, ensuring complete data delivery.
The packets will automatically switch to a different internet protocol like IP to avoid being dropped.
The sending computer will stop transmitting data completely until peak hours end.
answer: The destination computer will request retransmission for missing packets, ensuring complete data delivery.

prompt: Which of the following best describes a heuristic approach to solving a computationally difficult problem?
options: An approach that guarantees finding the single most optimal solution to a problem.
An approach that translates high-level programming language into machine code instructions.
An practical approach that finds a satisfactory, approximate solution when an exact solution takes too long.
An approach that uses a brute-force method to check every single possible answer sequence.
answer: An practical approach that finds a satisfactory, approximate solution when an exact solution takes too long.

prompt: Which of the following is a primary characteristic of a distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attack?
options: It decrypts secure files by trying every possible password combination.
It intercepts wireless network traffic to steal user credentials.
It uses multiple compromised computer systems to flood a target server with traffic.
It alters the source IP address of data packets to disguise their true origin.
answer: It uses multiple compromised computer systems to flood a target server with traffic.

prompt: Which of the following best describes the concept of open access in computing?
options: Allowing anyone online to edit the source code of private operating systems.
Providing online access to research and data free of financial or legal barriers.
Enabling universal connection to any secure network without a password.
A legal framework that automatically revokes copyright ownership from authors.
answer: Providing online access to research and data free of financial or legal barriers.

Which of the following is true about how data is routed on the Internet?
options: All packets belonging to a single message must travel along the exact same path.
The routing path for packets is predetermined before the message is sent.
Routers dynamic choose paths based on network traffic conditions.
Packets are strictly managed by a single central router that controls the entire internet.
answer: Routers dynamic choose paths based on network traffic conditions.

prompt: Which of the following best defines the 'digital divide'?
options: The speed difference between downloading and uploading files on a broadband network.
The computational gap between 32-bit hardware architectures and 64-bit architectures.
The socioeconomic inequality regarding access to modern information and communication technology.
The ideological division between open-source programmers and commercial developers.
answer: The socioeconomic inequality regarding access to modern information and communication technology.
